propositions: The Cloud differ's body-equality dedup key is computed via _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment using a plain 32767-character cap, while the send path acli_cli_ops.add_comment fits with AdfCodec.fit_outbound against a serialized 32000-byte ADF limit plus marker budget, causing the two to diverge for over-length comments around plain length ~31.8k.

For over-length comments the dedup key and actual landed body can never equal each other, breaking the secondary body-equality skip that guards against lost map writes between add_comment and record_comment_id.

The divergence was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 which moved the send path off the shared comment_limits.truncate_comment_body helper to AdfCodec.fit_outbound while leaving the differ on the plain cap, violating the comment_limits.py module's stated invariant.

Restoring convergence requires _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment to return the marker-free text the send path actually lands by composing fit_comment_as_sent with AdfCodec for Cloud, keeping Data Center's fitter unchanged and preserving the per-backend convergence guarantee.
The dedup key is never persisted (binding_store stores only local_comment_key to comment id mapping), so the fix cannot cause re-posts and can only add dedup skips for already-landed comments.

A separate rich-mode decode asymmetry exists where markdown comments within the limit fail body equality due to AdfCodec.normalize_outbound escaping brackets while inbound adf_to_text does not, requiring separate mitigation.
